# Whose Reading

*Arlo and Eilidh read last night's tide differently and argued about it. Ask Eilidh what she saw, look at the water from the cove rocks, and tell Arlo who was right.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Eilidh](../npcs/eilidh_child.md)
2. Reach the cove rocks in [Goa Harbour](../maps/goa_harbour.md)
